action_sequence: extract user data from profile (username, display_name, bio, company, followers)
tips: Use goto(url) to return to stargazers list instead of browser back—faster and more reliable
User avatars are clickable elements in the stargazers list; use index-based selectors
Profile data can be extracted from page title and sidebar without additional navigation
Follower count appears as a link element on the profile sidebar
avoid: Don't re-screenshot the same profile page multiple times—once per user is sufficient
Don't rely on selector indices that may shift; verify user identity in screenshot before extracting data
